tweets.text:
We just dropped a 15-part comprehensive report on AI spend in the enterprise.

Here are my top 3 takeaways:
- Spend grew 5.4x last year to $177B, with most spend coming from existing buyers
- Most dollars go to the frontier with 69% going to top 3 labs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) vs 50% last year
- 86% of LLM API spend goes to Anthropic (55%) and OpenAI (31%)

Crazy to think AI spend in our first report 3yrs ago was only $2.5B.
